flora: Metasequoia cone (small, globose, with horizontal scales)

environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'feathery' softness of the needles; vibrant reddish-brown bark; clear quadrant separation.
